pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 80 °C·d above 4 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)1000 °C·d$(). Best near 20 °C; stops above 32 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -5 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7.5 (tolerates 5.5-8.2). Roots 0.8 m. Dislikes waterlogging.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 150, P 15, K 70 kg/ha per crop; fixes about 70% of its own nitrogen.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 45 bu/ac (3 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Field Peas.
